verdict.rationale: Mem0 is API-first. Memory operations (add, search, scoping, expiration, export, webhooks) are documented as API/SDK features, and a published OpenAPI spec exists. Account and API-key creation can be done from the terminal with 'no email, no dashboard', and the CLI covers full memory CRUD. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard admin functions (API-key management, audit log, project settings) are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration.
